title: A fixed line total reports its parts amount in Fixed line total
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with line 1 with a fixed line total of $450.00 ($240.00 labor) holding two parts in category A, quantity 1 each, costs $30.00 and $10.00, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
  3. Open Reports › Sales By Customer.
  4. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • The Fixed line total row reads Parts Invoiced $210.00 ($450.00 − $240.00) and Parts Cost $40.00 ($30.00 + $10.00).
  • Its Parts Margin reads $170.00 and Parts Margin % 80.95% ($170.00 ÷ $210.00).
  • Tier A has no row for these parts.

Step 3:

  • Sales By Customer opens.

Step 4:

  • Customer A's Parts Invoiced reads $210.00: $210.00 − $210.00 = $0.00.
